code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    # Identify a full-length solid divider and the adjacent non-background object.
    for orient in ("v", "h"):
        n = w if orient == "v" else h
        m = h if orient == "v" else w
        for k in range(n):
            vals = [g[r][k] if orient == "v" else g[k][r] for r in range(m)]
            if len(set(vals)) != 1 or vals[0] == bg:
                continue
            line_color = vals[0]
            # Locate a non-bg object attached immediately to either side.
            for side in (-1, 1):
                q = k + side
                if not (0 <= q < n):
                    continue
                obj_cells = [(r, q) if orient == "v" else (q, r) for r in range(m)
                             if (g[r][q] if orient == "v" else g[q][r]) not in (bg, line_color)]

                outer = max(c if orient == "v" else r for r, c in obj_cells) if side == 1 else min(c if orient == "v" else r for r, c in obj_cells)
                target = outer + side
                if not (0 <= target < n):
                    continue
                for t in range(m):
                    if orient == "v":
                        g[t][target] = 8
                    else:
                        g[target][t] = 8
                return g
    return g
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    for orient in ("v", "h"):
        n = w if orient == "v" else h
        m = h if orient == "v" else w
        for k in range(n):
            vals = [g[r][k] if orient == "v" else g[k][r] for r in range(m)]
            if len(set(vals)) != 1 or vals[0] == bg:
                continue
            line_color = vals[0]
            for side in (-1, 1):
                q = k + side
                if not (0 <= q < n):
                    continue
                seed = [(r, q) if orient == "v" else (q, r) for r in range(m)
                        if (g[r][q] if orient == "v" else g[q][r]) not in (bg, line_color)]
                if not seed:
                    continue
                color = g[seed[0][0]][seed[0][1]]
                todo = list(seed); seen = set(seed)
                while todo:
                    r, c = todo.pop()
                    for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        rr, cc = r+dr, c+dc
                        if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and (rr,cc) not in seen and g[rr][cc] == color:
                            seen.add((rr,cc)); todo.append((rr,cc))
                coords = [c if orient == "v" else r for r,c in seen]
                outer = max(coords) if side == 1 else min(coords)
                target = outer + side
                if not 0 <= target < n:
                    continue
                for t in range(m):
                    if orient == "v": g[t][target] = 8
                    else: g[target][t] = 8
                return g
    return g
'''
